name: SmartStop Self Storage at Texas Avenue
summary: SmartStop at 3101 Texas Avenue South lists heated rooms and drive-up rooms. Checked Nov 28, 2026, the public offer list did not include a heated 5x5. A heated 5x10 is still listed at $29 online. The in-store price was not on that list. The move-in panel added a $29 admin fee when it was checked Nov 27, 2026. A drive-up 10x20 is $76 online on the Nov 28 offer list.
address: 3101 Texas Avenue South, College Station, TX 77845

fees.label: Administrative fee
fees.note: Shown on each unit's move-in panel as a one-time admin fee.

facts.label: Office hours
facts.value: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, and Friday 9:30 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Saturday 9:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m., Sunday 10:00 a.m. to 2:00 p.m. The week shown on Nov 27, 2026 lists Thursday closed for a holiday.

facts.label: Black Friday banner
facts.value: The page shows a banner that says Black Friday savings up to 60% off. The heated 10x10 is the room whose online price is 60% under the in-store price. The other rooms are not labeled at that percent.

facts.label: Military discount
facts.value: The facility page lists military discounts and does not print a percent or a dollar amount.

facts.label: 10x20 size description
facts.value: SmartStop's size guide says a 10x20 is like a large bedroom and can hold a small car, boat, or truck.

gaps: The page does not say how many months the online price lasts, except on rooms marked first month rent free.
Sales tax is not on the move-in panel.
The military discount is listed without a percent.
Driving miles from a campus building are not on the facility page.
